relationships.evidence_quote: since active MMP-1 catalyzes pro-MMP-9 by cleaving its bait region,11 upstream regulation of MMP-9 by MMP-1 may be responsible for their correlation

relationships.subject: MMP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Active MMP-1 and active MMP-9 correlate positively with self-reported pain scores (τ ≥ 0.51; p ≤ 0.04), suggesting their involvement in peripheral nociception.
